description: Check your remaining ifrCoworker credits without consuming any. Returns creditsRemaining, creditsUsedToday, fullAccess flag, and a cost estimate for batch calls. FREE — does not decrement quota. Call before a large batch to verify you have enough credits. batchCostEstimate.perItem = credits per successfully computed batch item; batchCostEstimate.preflightFree = true (validation phase never charges).
name: ifr_check_quota
